#### Natural Language Query Interface
```typescript
// components/analytics/QueryInterface.tsx
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/Input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/Card';
import { Sparkles, Send, History } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNaturalLanguageQuery } from '@/hooks/useNaturalLanguageQuery';

interface QueryInterfaceProps {
  onQuerySubmit: (query: string, sqlQuery?: string) => void;
  suggestions?: string[];
  recentQueries?: string[];
}

export const QueryInterface: React.FC<QueryInterfaceProps> = ({
  onQuerySubmit,
  suggestions = [],
  recentQueries = []
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'natural' | 'sql'>('natural');
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  
  const {
    suggestions: nlSuggestions,
    isProcessing,
    convertToSQL
  } = useNaturalLanguageQuery();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!query.trim()) return;

    if (mode === 'natural') {
      const sqlQuery = await convertToSQL(query);
      onQuerySubmit(query, sqlQuery);
    } else {
      onQuerySubmit(query);
    }
    
    setQuery('');
  };

  const handleSuggestionClick = (suggestion: string) => {
    setQuery(suggestion);
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <Card className="p-6">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Ask your data a question</h3>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex rounded-lg bg-gray-100 p-1">
            <Button
              variant={mode === 'natural' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setMode('natural')}
            >
              Natural Language
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={mode === 'sql' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setMode('sql')}
            >
              SQL
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <Input
              ref={inputRef}
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={
                mode === 'natural'
                  ? "e.g., Show me sales by region for this quarter"
                  : "SELECT * FROM sales WHERE..."
              }
              className="text-lg py-3 pr-12"
              disabled={isProcessing}
            />
            <Button
              type="submit"
              size="sm"
              className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
              disabled={!query.trim() || isProcessing}
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <div className="animate-spin h-4 w-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full" />
              ) : (
                <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>

          {mode === 'natural' && nlSuggestions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Suggestions:</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {nlSuggestions.map((suggestion, index) => (
                  <Button
                    key={index}
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => handleSuggestionClick(suggestion)}
                  >
                    {suggestion}
                  </Button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </form>

        {recentQueries.length > 0 && (
          <div className="border-t pt-4">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mb-3">
              <History className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Recent Queries</span>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              {recentQueries.slice(0, 3).map((recentQuery, index) => (
                <button
                  key={index}
                  onClick={() => handleSuggestionClick(recentQuery)}
                  className="block w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 p-2 rounded transition-colors"
                >
                  {recentQuery}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
};
```

#### Advanced Chart Components
```typescript
// components/charts/ChartContainer.tsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  LineChart, Line, BarChart, Bar, AreaChart, Area,
  PieChart, Pie, Cell, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer
} from 'recharts';

export interface ChartConfig {
  xKey: string;
  yKey: string | string[];
  colors: string[];
  showGrid?: boolean;
  showLegend?: boolean;
  showTooltip?: boolean;
  formatters?: {
    x?: (value: any) => string;
    y?: (value: any) => string;
  };
}

interface ChartContainerProps {
  type: 'line' | 'bar' | 'area' | 'pie';
  data: any[];
  config: ChartConfig;
  height?: number;
  loading?: boolean;
}

export const ChartContainer: React.FC<ChartContainerProps> = ({
  type,
  data,
  config,
  height = 300,
  loading = false
}) => {
  if (loading) {
    return <ChartSkeleton height={height} />;
  }

  const commonProps = {
    data,
    margin: { top: 20, right: 30, left: 20, bottom: 20 }
  };

  const renderChart = () => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'line':
        return (
          <LineChart {...commonProps}>
            {config.showGrid && <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#E5E7EB" />}
            <XAxis 
              dataKey={config.xKey}
              stroke="#6B7280"
              fontSize={12}
              tickFormatter={config.formatters?.x}
            />
            <YAxis 
              stroke="#6B7280"
              fontSize={12}
              tickFormatter={config.formatters?.y}
            />
            {config.showTooltip && <CustomTooltip />}
            {config.showLegend && <Legend />}
            {Array.isArray(config.yKey) ? (
              config.yKey.map((key, index) => (
                <Line
                  key={key}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={key}
                  stroke={config.colors[index]}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  dot={{ r: 4 }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 6 }}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <Line
                type="monotone"
                dataKey={config.yKey}
                stroke={config.colors[0]}
                strokeWidth={2}
                dot={{ r: 4 }}
                activeDot={{ r: 6 }}
              />
            )}
          </LineChart>
        );

      case 'bar':
        return (
          <BarChart {...commonProps}>
            {config.showGrid && <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#E5E7EB" />}
            <XAxis 
              dataKey={config.xKey}
              stroke="#6B7280"
              fontSize={12}
              tickFormatter={config.formatters?.x}
            />
            <YAxis 
              stroke="#6B7280"
              fontSize={12}
              tickFormatter={config.formatters?.y}
            />
            {config.showTooltip && <CustomTooltip />}
            {config.showLegend && <Legend />}
            {Array.isArray(config.yKey) ? (
              config.yKey.map((key, index) => (
                <Bar
                  key={key}
                  dataKey={key}
                  fill={config.colors[index]}
                  radius={[2, 2, 0, 0]}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <Bar
                dataKey={config.yKey}
                fill={config.colors[0]}
                radius={[2, 2, 0, 0]}
              />
            )}
          </BarChart>
        );

      case 'area':
        return (
          <AreaChart {...commonProps}>
            {config.showGrid && <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#E5E7EB" />}
            <XAxis 
              dataKey={config.xKey}
              stroke="#6B7280"
              fontSize={12}
              tickFormatter={config.formatters?.x}
            />
            <YAxis 
              stroke="#6B7280"
              fontSize={12}
              tickFormatter={config.formatters?.y}
            />
            {config.showTooltip && <CustomTooltip />}
            {config.showLegend && <Legend />}
            <Area
              type="monotone"
              dataKey={config.yKey}
              stroke={config.colors[0]}
              fill={config.colors[0]}
              fillOpacity={0.1}
            />
          </AreaChart>
        );

      case 'pie':
        return (
          <PieChart {...commonProps}>
            <Pie
              data={data}
              dataKey={config.yKey}
              nameKey={config.xKey}
              cx="50%"
              cy="50%"
              outerRadius={80}
              label={({ name, percent }) => `${name}: ${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
            >
              {data.map((_, index) => (
                <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={config.colors[index % config.colors.length]} />
              ))}
            </Pie>
            {config.showTooltip && <CustomTooltip />}
          </PieChart>
        );

      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full" style={{ height }}>
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
        {renderChart()}
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Core API Implementations

#### Dashboard Management API
```typescript
// src/controllers/dashboardController.ts
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { DashboardService } from '../services/DashboardService';
import { z } from 'zod';

const createDashboardSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1).max(100),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  template: z.string().optional(),
  isPublic: z.boolean().default(false),
  layout: z.object({
    components: z.array(z.object({
      id: z.string(),
      type: z.enum(['chart', 'metric', 'table', 'text']),
      position: z.object({
        x: z.number(),
        y: z.number(),
        w: z.number(),
        h: z.number()
      }),
      config: z.record(z.any())
    }))
  })
});

export class DashboardController {
  constructor(private dashboardService: DashboardService) {}

  async createDashboard(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const data = createDashboardSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const dashboard = await this.dashboardService.create({
        ...data,
        userId,
        organizationId: req.user.organizationId
      });

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: dashboard
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Internal server error'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  async getDashboards(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const { page = 1, limit = 20, search, tags } = req.query;
      
      const dashboards = await this.dashboardService.findMany({
        userId,
        organizationId: req.user.organizationId,
        search: search as string,
        tags: tags as string[],
        pagination: {
          page: Number(page),
          limit: Number(limit)
        }
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: dashboards.data,
        pagination: dashboards.pagination
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to fetch dashboards'
      });
    }
  }

  async getDashboard(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      
      const dashboard = await this.dashboardService.findById(id, userId);
      
      if (!dashboard) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Dashboard not found'
        });
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: dashboard
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to fetch dashboard'
      });
    }
  }

  async updateDashboard(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const updates = req.body;
      
      const dashboard = await this.dashboardService.update(id, updates, userId);
      
      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: dashboard
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to update dashboard'
      });
    }
  }

  async deleteDashboard(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      
      await this.dashboardService.delete(id, userId);
      
      res.status(204).send();
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to delete dashboard'
      });
    }
  }
}
```

#### Natural Language Processing API
```typescript
// src/controllers/queryController.ts
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { QueryService } from '../services/QueryService';
import { NLPService } from '../services/NLPService';

export class QueryController {
  constructor(
    private queryService: QueryService,
    private nlpService: NLPService
  ) {}

  async processNaturalLanguageQuery(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const { query, dataSourceId } = req.body;
      const userId = req.user.id;

      // Parse natural language to SQL
      const sqlQuery = await this.nlpService.convertToSQL(query, {
        dataSourceId,
        userId,
        organizationId: req.user.organizationId
      });

      // Validate SQL query for security
      const validationResult = await this.queryService.validateQuery(sqlQuery);
      if (!validationResult.isValid) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Invalid or unsafe query',
          details: validationResult.errors
        });
      }

      // Execute query
      const results = await this.queryService.executeQuery({
        sql: sqlQuery,
        dataSourceId,
        userId,
        cacheKey: `nlq_${Buffer.from(query).toString('base64')}`
      });

      // Generate insights
      const insights = await this.nlpService.generateInsights(results.data);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          originalQuery: query,
          sqlQuery,
          results: results.data,
          insights,
          executionTime: results.executionTime,
          fromCache: results.fromCache
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to process query'
      });
    }
  }

  async executeSQLQuery(req: Request, res: Response) {
    try {
      const { sql, dataSourceId } = req.body;
      const userId = req.user.id;

      // Validate SQL query
      const validationResult = await this.queryService.validateQuery(sql);
      if (!validationResult.isValid) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Invalid SQL query',
          details: validationResult.errors
        });
      }

      // Execute query with timeout and resource limits
      const results = await this.queryService.executeQuery({
        sql,
        dataSourceId,
        userId,
        timeout: 30000, // 30 seconds
        maxRows: 10000
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: results
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Query execution failed'
      });
    }
  }
}
```

## Database Schema (PostgreSQL)

### Prisma Schema Definition
```prisma
// prisma/schema.prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Organization {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  slug        String   @unique
  plan        String   @default("starter") // starter, professional, enterprise
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  users       User[]
  dashboards  Dashboard[]
  dataSources DataSource[]
  queries     Query[]

  @@map("organizations")
}

model User {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  email          String   @unique
  name           String?
  avatar         String?
  role           String   @default("user") // admin, user, viewer
  isActive       Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  organizationId String
  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  dashboards     Dashboard[]
  queries        Query[]
  insights       Insight[]

  @@map("users")
}

model Dashboard {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  description String?
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(false)
  layout      Json     // Dashboard layout and component configuration
  tags        String[]
  viewCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  userId         String
  user           User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  organizationId String
  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  insights       Insight[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("dashboards")
}

model DataSource {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  type          String   // postgresql, mysql, mongodb, api, csv
  config        Json     // Connection configuration (encrypted)
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  lastSyncAt    DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  organizationId String
  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  queries        Query[]

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("data_sources")
}

model Query {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String?
  naturalQuery  String?   // Original natural language query
  sqlQuery      String    // Generated or written SQL
  results       Json?     // Cached query results
  executionTime Int?      // Execution time in milliseconds
  status        String    @default("pending") // pending, success, error
  error         String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  userId         String
  user           User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  organizationId String
  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  dataSourceId   String
  dataSource     DataSource   @relation(fields: [dataSourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  insights       Insight[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([dataSourceId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("queries")
}

model Insight {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  type        String   // anomaly, trend, forecast, correlation
  title       String
  description String
  confidence  Float    // 0.0 to 1.0
  data        Json     // Supporting data and metrics
  isRead      Boolean  @default(false)
  isBookmarked Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  userId      String
  user        User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  dashboardId String?
  dashboard   Dashboard? @relation(fields: [dashboardId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  queryId     String?
  query       Query?    @relation(fields: [queryId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([type])
  @@map("insights")
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  action    String   // create, update, delete, view, export
  resource  String   // dashboard, query, user, etc.
  resourceId String?
  userId    String
  userEmail String
  organizationId String
  metadata  Json?
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([action, resource])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}
```

## Authentication System Implementation

### JWT-Based Authentication with Role Management
```typescript
// src/middleware/auth.ts
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

interface JWTPayload {
  userId: string;
  organizationId: string;
  role: string;
  email: string;
}

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      user: JWTPayload;
    }
  }
}

export const authenticate = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
    
    if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Authorization token required'
      });
    }

    const token = authHeader.substring(7);
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET!) as JWTPayload;

    // Verify user still exists and is active
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: decoded.userId },
      include: { organization: true }
    });

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Invalid or expired token'
      });
    }

    req.user = {
      userId: user.id,
      organizationId: user.organizationId,
      role: user.role,
      email: user.email
    };

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid token'
    });
  }
};

export const authorize = (...roles: string[]) => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    if (!roles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Insufficient permissions'
      });
    }
    next();
  };
};
```

### SSO Integration (SAML/OAuth)
```typescript
// src/services/SSOService.ts
import { Strategy as SAMLStrategy } from 'passport-saml';
import { Strategy as GoogleStrategy } from 'passport-google-oauth20';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

export class SSOService {
  configureSAML() {
    return new SAMLStrategy({
      entryPoint: process.env.SAML_ENTRY_POINT!,
      issuer: process.env.SAML_ISSUER!,
      cert: process.env.SAML_CERT!,
      callbackUrl: `${process.env.APP_URL}/auth/saml/callback`
    }, async (profile, done) => {
      try {
        const user = await this.findOrCreateUser({
          email: profile.email,
          name: profile.displayName,
          organizationSlug: profile.organization
        });
        done(null, user);
      } catch (error) {
        done(error);
      }
    });
  }

  configureGoogle() {
    return new GoogleStrategy({
      clientID: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID!,
      clientSecret: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET!,
      callbackURL: `${process.env.APP_URL}/auth/google/callback`
    }, async (accessToken, refreshToken, profile, done) => {
      try {
        const user = await this.findOrCreateUser({
          email: profile.emails[0].value,
          name: profile.displayName,
          avatar: profile.photos[0].value
        });
        done(null, user);
      } catch (error) {
        done(error);
      }
    });
  }

  private async findOrCreateUser(userData: {
    email: string;
    name?: string;
    avatar?: string;
    organizationSlug?: string;
  }) {
    let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: userData.email },
      include: { organization: true }
    });

    if (!user) {
      // Create organization if specified
      let organization;
      if (userData.organizationSlug) {
        organization = await prisma.organization.upsert({
          where: { slug: userData.organizationSlug },
          update: {},
          create: {
            name: userData.organizationSlug,
            slug: userData.organizationSlug
          }
        });
      } else {
        // Create personal organization
        const orgSlug = userData.email.split('@')[0];
        organization = await prisma.organization.create({
          data: {
            name: `${userData.name}'s Organization`,
            slug: orgSlug
          }
        });
      }

      user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          email: userData.email,
          name: userData.name,
          avatar: userData.avatar,
          organizationId: organization.id,
          role: 'admin' // First user in org is admin
        },
        include: { organization: true }
      });
    }

    return user;
  }

  generateTokens(user: any) {
    const payload = {
      userId: user.id,
      organizationId: user.organizationId,
      role: user.role,
      email: user.email
    };

    const accessToken = jwt.sign(payload, process.env.JWT_SECRET!, {
      expiresIn: '15m'
    });

    const refreshToken = jwt.sign(payload, process.env.REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET!, {
      expiresIn: '7d'
    });

    return { accessToken, refreshToken };
  }
}
```

## Redis Integration for Caching and Real-time Features

### Cache Layer Implementation
```typescript
// src/lib/cache.ts
import Redis from 'ioredis';

const redis = new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL!);

export class CacheService {
  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    try {
      const value = await redis.get(key);
      return value ? JSON.parse(value) : null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache get error:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set(key: string, value: any, ttlSeconds: number = 3600): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await redis.setex(key, ttlSeconds, JSON.stringify(value));
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache set error:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  async del(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await redis.del(key);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache delete error:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  async invalidatePattern(pattern: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const keys = await redis.keys(pattern);
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        await redis.del(...keys);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache invalidate error:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Real-time pub/sub for dashboard updates
  async publishDashboardUpdate(dashboardId: string, data: any): Promise<void> {
    await redis.publish(`dashboard:${dashboardId}:update`, JSON.stringify(data));
  }

  subscribeToDashboardUpdates(dashboardId: string, callback: (data: any) => void) {
    const subscriber = new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL!);
    subscriber.subscribe(`dashboard:${dashboardId}:update`);
    subscriber.on('message', (channel, message) => {
      callback(JSON.parse(message));
    });
    return subscriber;
  }
}

export const cache = new CacheService();
```
